title: chat-00: rateLimited duplicates RFC 8620 rateLimit
description: chat-00 :1914 registers a new error type rateLimited used as a Message/set SetError for slow mode; RFC 8620 5.3 already defines SetError rateLimit. Federation uses rateLimited as a method-level error (no RFC 8620 equivalent). scene-00 uses rateLimit. Decide: reuse rateLimit for SetErrors and keep rateLimited only as a method-level error, or keep as is.
